# VectorFlowField

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mathematical representation of optical signal propagation directions and magnitudes across the photonic network, used to guide adaptive routing decisions. Enables dynamic reconfiguration of optical paths in response to traffic patterns, essential for efficient resource utilization in TCC systems.
